messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — we need a concrete contract for the per-route SLO panels. Product wants P50/P95/P99 + TTFT (ms) + tokens/sec per route/model. Who owns telemetry tags and metric names?

Ava: @Morgan I can drive the dashboard layout, but we need runtime to guarantee tags. right now some routes come through as `route` and others only as `model_name`.

Diego: I own the runtime emit. We can add `route_id`, `model_name`, `variant`, `shard` tags. question: do you need fine-grained shard or just route/model?

Priya: Product: route_id + model_name + variant. Shard only if it affects SLOs (eg hot shards). Start simple, we can add shard later.

Linh: FYI metrics we currently have: `latency.p50_ms`, `latency.p95_ms`, `latency.p99_ms`, `tokens.sent_total`, `tokens.per_second` (derived). But naming is inconsistent across services.

Diego: plan: runtime will emit `runtime.latency.{p50|p95|p99}_ms` and `runtime.ttft_ms` and a monotonic `runtime.tokens_total`. We'll add label `route_id` and `model_name`. Can someone confirm panel query examples?

Ava: For Grafana/Console panels we'll use queries like:
```
avg by (route_id, model_name) (rate(runtime.tokens_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(runtime.ttft_ms[5m]) by (route_id, model_name)
50th_percentile(runtime.latency.p50_ms) by (route_id, model_name)
```
This is pseudo-querying, just to show expectations.

Kalen: two concerns: 1) cardinality if customers create many dynamic routes; 2) sampling for TTFT — do we emit TTFT for every request?

Diego: we'll emit TTFT for sampled requests (configurable). Default sampling 1/10k, + option to opt-in per-dedicated-customer to 100%. We'll also add a `route_type` tag (static|dynamic) so console can auto-collapse dynamic routes.

Morgan: Nice. On cardinality, Product asks for per-route SLOs when route count <= 500; otherwise aggregate by product/team. Can we add `team_id` tag upstream?

Priya: yes, we can map route->team in console. But runtime needs to emit the `route_id` and we keep a mapping service.

Linh: will standardize names in metrics repo today and add a lightweight shim in metrics-ingest that translates old names to the new `runtime.*` prefix.

SRE-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics-ingest rename shim -> canary to staging at 2026-02-18T15:30:00Z :warning:

Ava: UX notes for console panels: allow toggle P50/P95/P99, show TTFT median and 95, and tokens/sec heatmap. Also panel should link to rollout config for that route.

Diego: runtime PR incoming — I'll add the labels and sampling flags. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Kalen: can we include an example alert rule? e.g., `avg_over_time(runtime.ttft_ms{route_id=~"^checkout.*"}[5m]) > 2000` for high TTFT.

Priya: yes, product wants templated alert snippets for the console so teams can enable with one click.

Morgan: Ok owners: runtime (Diego) -> emit + sampling flag, metrics-ingest (Linh) -> rename shim, dashboard (Ava) -> panel templates + alert snippets, product (Priya) -> route->team mapping + UX copy. Kalen will review alert drafts.

Diego: noted. I'll post the PR link here when ready.

Ava: I'll draft panel mockups and share tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Morgan: Thanks — feel free to @me on blockers. End of thread.
